notes.title: 🚽 Welcome to Toilet Clicker!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hey everyone[/b] — and welcome to the [b]first-ever Toilet Clicker update post![/b][/h2][h3]Whether you found this game on Steam, Kickstarter, or just stumbled in by accident… I’m really glad you’re here. 


[b][u]What [i]is[/i] Toilet Clicker?[/u][/b][/h3][h3]Toilet Clicker is a chaotic, fast-paced indie clicker game, full of various minigames, where you press a toilet, buy upgrades, collect flushes and gather hundreds of weird, cursed, and hilarious items. Every click is a surprise — sometimes it’s trash, sometimes it’s treasure (and sometimes it’s… questionable).[/h3][h3]I started this project as a solo dev with a simple goal:
[b]Make something fun, weird, and endlessly satisfying to play.[/b]
[i][strike]And it’s growing fast.


[/strike][/i][b][u]What's Already In?[/u][/b]
✅ over 50 Upgrades — boost your flushes and drop rates.
✅ 4 Minigames — short, silly and quite challenging events before item drops, 
✅ Idle income — earn even when your game is turned off,
✅ Quality-of-life improvements all around,
✅ 50 Unique, and [b]RIDICULOUS [/b]items, of various rarities, and more on the way!
✅ Evolution system, which makes the game worth re-playing,
✅ Item Album — keep track of your items, and feel the progression!

[/h3][p][i]More features are on the way!

[/i][/p][h3][b][u]🫧 Be Part of the Community[/u][/b][/h3][p]Want to suggest your own item ideas? Report bugs? Hang out with other flushers?[/p][p]We’ve got a [b]Discord server[/b] where all of that’s happening:
[/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.gg/zBFbEHgcFs" style="button"]Link Here[/url]

[i]also pssst, you can test the game here.
